title: Jair
description: Ruler of Israel. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-14 (Table 5, "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Column: Ruler of Israel; Name row (Year BC): 1192; Last regnal-year row (Year BC): 1171 (year 22). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 785b
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2798. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2798 = 1235 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

reign.date: Column: Ruler of Israel; Name row (Year BC): 1192; Last regnal-year row (Year BC): 1171 (year 22)
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-14: Ancient Assyria," OSF preprint v1.0 (27 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9FUW2, file CFAH-14_Assyria_v_1.0.pdf, Table 5 "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)", pp. 49–52
reign.note: Row "Jair" of Table 5 (Israel). Year-by-year table (1262-963 BC). A ruler's name is printed in one year row and his regnal-year numbers in the following rows; each row here gives the Year BC of the name row and of the last numbered row, as printed. No year is computed from a length.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 785b
reign.note: Year cell "3480 2798 285". The third printed figure 285 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 22 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Israel..
